evals.prompt: What does the wiki say about three-layer-architecture? target_wiki: <TARGET_WIKI>.
evals.expected_output: Coverage: covered. Answer drawn from concepts/three-layer-architecture.md plus possibly llm-wiki-pattern.md and the source page; every factual sentence carries a `^[src:karpathy-llm-wiki-2026:§...]` marker reused from those pages.
expectations: Output starts with `# wiki-query answer —` and contains the deterministic template (Question, Coverage, Answer, Sources used, Confidence)
Answer contains at least one `^[src:karpathy-llm-wiki-2026:` citation marker

Every citation marker in the answer points at a heading slug that exists in the source raw file (one of: the-core-idea, architecture, operations, indexing-and-logging, optional-cli-tools, tips-and-tricks, why-this-works, note)
Skill did not modify any wiki content (read-only)

evals.prompt: What does this wiki say about prompt injection defenses? target_wiki: <TARGET_WIKI>.
evals.expected_output: Coverage: none. The wiki has no page on prompt injection. Skill says so explicitly and recommends `wiki-ingest`. No fabricated citations.
expectations: Coverage is `none` (or, at most, `partial` if a tangential mention exists)
The Answer section explicitly says the wiki does not cover this topic — does NOT silently provide a memory-based answer
The Answer section contains zero `^[src:` markers (no fabricated citations)
The Answer recommends `wiki-ingest` as the right next action, OR notes the topic is out of scope and recommends a new wiki via `wiki-llm-builder`
If a memory-based off-wiki answer IS provided, it appears in a clearly separate `Off-wiki answer` or `(Off-wiki note)` subsection, NOT mixed into the cited body

evals.prompt: List all entities in this wiki with one-line descriptions. target_wiki: <TARGET_WIKI>.
evals.expected_output: A structured list (table or bullets) enumerating each entity page in entities/, with a one-line description per row. Sources used should be the entity pages themselves.
expectations: Answer is a structured list (markdown table or bullets), NOT a prose paragraph
The list contains at least the entities currently in the wiki: qmd, obsidian
Each row/bullet has a one-line description, not just the slug
